_about: The Paladin's Stage 0 cards in the card Structure of 2026-11-16 (book/cards/card-structure.md). THE BOOK reads these in the place of the cards of the same name in ../paladin.json; Foundry reads these since pack F2 (v0.0.409; load.mjs loadFoundryCards, each card's `foundry` block: its automation; a block's `foundry` is its Version's, a one-Version card's is `foundry.version`); the ruler still reads ../paladin.json until its own pass. Format: name, category and level (data, not printed), flavor, traits, escalation, frequency, cost (the bar's text: '2 AP', '1R', '1 or 2 AP', 'Passive'), distance, area, target, body (labeled lines in play order: {label, text}), blocks (a Version or a Mode: heading, traits only it has, its own distance / target, its body).

cards.name: Judge
cards.flavor: You pronounce a foe guilty before your god, and holy light dulls its blows against those who stand near you.

body.label: Judged
body.text: A creature stops being Judged when it goes Down. A creature Judged by you counts as Profane for you. Once each round, when it damages an ally within 5 squares of you, you can reduce that damage by your Power Modifier. Multiple Paladins can Judge the same creature: it is Judged by each of them.

body.label: Special
body.text: You can use this only at the start of an encounter, or as a 0R when the creature you Judged goes Down.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target is Judged by you (EoE).

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target is Judged by you (EoE). If another creature was Judged by you, it no longer is.

foundry.automationNote: the mark (the ring on the token), Profane for you (Smite's and Word of Radiance's d8s, your Profane rules), once each round, the Judged creature's damage to an ally within 5 squares of you reduced by your Power Modifier if you choose (you're asked when it lands), the reminders at the start of an encounter and when it goes Down; the 0 AP use only at the start of an encounter or as a 0R: by hand.

settings.text: choose a creature to Judge. Target it and use Judge:
{mark}, the creature you Judged, went Down. Judge another (0R): target it and use Judge:

cards.name: Smite
cards.flavor: Holy light gathers on your weapon as the fight wears on, and you bring all of it down in one blow.

body.label: Smite dice
body.text: [R] 1d6! Ho for each Escalation you have, up to 4 dice. Against a Profane creature they are 1d8!s.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: [V] 1[W] + [Mod] + your Smite dice + 1 more Smite die.

body.label: Special
body.text: When you use Smite, you can spend your Reaction Point to roll 1 more Smite die. Neither extra die counts toward the 4.

foundry.automationNote: the Smite dice by your Escalation (up to 4, 1 more on a Tier 3), d8s against a Profane creature (Judged by you, or the Profane Tag), the Reaction Point for 1 more die (the roll dialog's chip, paid when used).

cards.name: Sworn Blade
cards._note: 2026-11-22 (Lucas, the core rework batch 3, `cards/basic-attacks-redesign.md`): the Paladin's line on the shared Basic Attack.
cards.flavor: Each blow you swear by turns a shaken foe where you want it.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Your [[Basic Attack]] gains: **Strained:** You can Slide the target 1.

foundry.automationNote: on your Basic Attack, after its damage lands on a Strained target, the Slide 1 runs (you can decline it).

cards.name: Drawing Light
cards._note: 2026-11-22 (Lucas, the core rework batch 3, `cards/basic-attacks-redesign.md`): the Paladin's Power Basic attack (no [Mod] in its damage, Lucas).
cards.flavor: A cord of light catches them and hauls them toward you.

body.label: Bloodied
body.text: You can Slide the target instead.

foundry.automationNote: the damage and the Pull; a Critical's 1d10! (a Basic attack); the Bloodied line's Slide instead of the Pull: by hand.

cards.name: Binding Light
cards.flavor: Your blow lands wreathed in light that roots your foe where it stands.

foundry.automationNote: the damage, then Immobilized (1 round) on a Tier 2 or 3 once it lands.

cards.name: Lay On Hands
cards.flavor: You stride to an ally's side and lay a hand on them, and a skin of pale light settles over them.

body.label: Setup
body.text: You Advance up to 5 squares in a straight line toward the target.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target gains Guard equal to 2 + your Power Modifier.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target gains Guard equal to 2 + your Power Modifier and can use 1 Rally Point.

foundry.automationNote: the Setup's Advance (the button; the straight line toward the target by hand), the Guard (2 + Pow) and, at 2 AP, the Rally Point (the chips, on the target).

cards.name: Shield of Faith
cards.flavor: You raise a hand, and a pane of light turns part of the blow aside and pulls your foe's eye to you.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: An enemy's [Strike] Action would damage the target.

body.label: Effect
body.text: That damage is reduced by 1 + your Power Modifier, and the triggering creature is Taunted by you (1 round).

foundry.automationNote: offered by itself in the Reactions message when an enemy's Strike would damage an ally within 5 squares (the damage waits); Use reduces that damage by 1 + Pow and Taunts the attacker (1 round).

cards.name: Rebuke
cards.flavor: You call out in your god's name, and your foe's stride falters and stops.

body.label: Trigger
body.text: The target moves away from you.

foundry.automationNote: offered by itself in the Reactions message when an enemy within 3 squares moves away from you; Use makes the Appeal Save and the enemy is Hindered (EoT); on a Tier 1 or 2 its Move Action is disrupted: Move back in the Reactions message (to the square it left).

cards.name: Lantern of Faith
cards.flavor: You call your god's light: around you, onto a foe, or into a foe's eyes.

foundry.automationNote: the Mode's pick; Kindle and Reveal light the token (an effect); Glare's Instinct Save and Half-Blinded (EoT).

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.flavor: You plant yourself where the fight is worst: you crowd the ground at your feet, trade places with an ally, or carry one clear.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The squares adjacent to you now are Difficult Terrain for enemies (1 round). They stay where they are if you move.

blocks.heading: Trade Places

body.label: Effect
body.text: You and the target swap squares. Each of you is moved by a Reposition.

blocks.target: One willing ally of your Size

foundry.automationNote: the Mode's pick; Brace (an Aura 1 around you, Difficult Terrain for enemies, 1 round; the book fixes the squares when you use it: if you move, by hand); Trade Places (the Swap button: both tokens move at once, no Reactions; different Sizes refused); Rescue's Reposition 2 (the button).

cards.name: Commandment
cards.flavor: You speak with your god's authority: you call a foe to face you, steady the hearts around you, or order a foe to its knees.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target is Taunted by you (1 round).

body.label: Effect
body.text: An [[Aura]] 3 around you (1 round): you and your allies in it ignore the Daunted condition.

foundry.automationNote: the Mode's pick; Challenge's Taunted (1 round); Kneel's Appeal Save and Prone; Courage: an effect on you as a reminder (an Aura 3: you and allies in it ignore Daunted: by hand).

cards._note: 2026-11-22 (Lucas, the core rework batch 3, `cards/basic-attacks-redesign.md`): Kneel's Prone only on a Tier 1 (it landed 77 to 81%), Hindered (EoT) on a Tier 2.

cards.name: Armor of Faith
cards.flavor: Each time you answer for an ally, your god's light settles on you like mail.

body.label: Passive
body.text: When you use a [Divine] Reaction (not Judge's 0R), you gain Guard equal to 1 + your Power Modifier.

foundry.automationNote: the Guard (1 + Pow, the higher kept) each time you use a [Divine] Reaction, while your Escalation is 2 or more.

cards.name: Roving Judgment
cards.flavor: Your eye passes from one guilty foe to the next, and your god's attention follows it.

body.label: Passive
body.text: The 1 AP use of Judge costs you 0 AP.

foundry.automationNote: Judge's 1 AP Version costs 0 AP while your Escalation is 2 or more.

cards.name: Kindled Wrath
cards.flavor: An ally's blood on the ground, and your god's anger is yours.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once an encounter, when an ally becomes Bloodied or goes Down, your Escalation increases by 1.

cards.name: Bulwark of Faith
cards.flavor: You step into the blow meant for them, and your god holds the line with you.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: An enemy's [Strike] Action would damage the target.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target gains Guard equal to what one of their Rally Points heals, before the damage. After the damage, they are Slid 1.

foundry.automationNote: offered by itself in the Reactions message when an enemy's Strike would damage an ally within 5 squares (the damage waits); Use gives the Guard (one of their Rally Points) before it lands, then Slides them 1 after.

cards.name: Consecrated Ground
cards.flavor: You drive your weapon into the earth and the ground around it shines: your foes wade through it, and your allies stand firmer on it.

body.label: Effect
body.text: For 3 rounds, the Area is Difficult Terrain for enemies. Whenever you or an ally starts a turn in the Area, that creature gains Guard equal to your Power Modifier.

foundry.automationNote: the Zone (3 rounds): Difficult Terrain for enemies, and you and your allies who start a turn in it gain Guard equal to your Power Modifier.

cards.name: Word of Radiance
cards.flavor: You speak a single word of your god, and light bursts from you: your foes burn in it and stagger back.

body.label: Special
body.text: Against a Profane creature, the damage dice are d8s.

foundry.automationNote: the Emanation around you, the Appeal Save and the damage of each enemy (d8s against a Profane one), then the Pushes one by one from you (3 / 2 / 1 by the Tier).

cards.name: Weight of Judgment
cards.flavor: Your judgment hangs on your foe like a chain, and its steps drag.

body.label: Passive
body.text: A creature Judged by you has its Speed reduced by 2 (to a minimum of 1).

foundry.automationNote: the Speed of the creature you Judged: by hand (its Speed reduced by 2, to a minimum of 1).

cards.name: Tireless Vigil
cards.flavor: The longer the fight lasts, the less escapes you: your guard is on two allies at once.

body.label: Passive
body.text: You gain 1 more Reaction Point when you regain AP. It pays only for [Divine] Reactions.

foundry.automationNote: the second Reaction Point while your Escalation is 4 or more; that it pays only for [Divine] Reactions: by hand.

cards.name: Reckoning
cards.flavor: You stride among your foes, and your god's light breaks from you and throws them back.

foundry.automationNote: the Setup's Advance (the button), then the Emanation around you, the Pushes one by one and the Appeal Save: Daunted of you (1 round) on a Tier 1 or 2.

cards.name: Hallowed Stance
cards.flavor: Your god's light carries you: wherever you are needed, you are already there.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once on your turn, a [Divine] Action you use gains "Setup: You Advance 3."

foundry.automationNote: a [Divine] Action you use shows "Setup: You Advance 3" with its button while your Escalation is 6 or more; once on your turn: by hand.
